# PTS Patchnotes: "Burning Springs" (Patch 64)

![PTS Patchnotes: `Burning Springs` (Patch 64)](/uploads/564_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Der neue "Burning Springs" PTS (Public Test Server) ist nun verfügbar. Hier sind die Patchnotes.

### Index

## PTS Patchnotes 18.11.2025

PTS Update – November 18, 2025Hey Everyone! This will be our final PTS update before Burning Springs releases on December 2. We have a log of other topics that we’ll be targeting fixes for in future patches, including providing fixes for reports around clipping, pathing, correcting build costs and other improvements to the new region.Burning Springs**Quest**

- Welcoming Committee – Ambush Captain’s armor now appears correctly on the captain.
**Misc**

Help menu entries have been added to support Burning Springs content.
Rust Raider Light, Medium, and Heavy Outfits can now be stashed in a player stash, but cannot be traded, dropped, vended or placed into a world container.
Deathclaw Tamer outfit can now be sold to NPC vendors.
Gearin’ Up Event now has animation on event start.
**Bounty Hunting**

- Players are no longer unable to start another Grunt Hunt if you exit the game before the initial quest completes.

## PTS Patchnotes 07.11.2025

PTS Update – November 7, 2025Hey all!This weekend you'll notice that Gearin' Up and Sinkhole Solutions won't be running every 20 minutes like usual, but Fasnacht will be activated.If possible, we'd like you all to play on Adventure Mode servers and focus on running Fasnachts, Grunt Hunts, and Bounty Hunts events.Gearin' Up and Sinkhole Solutions will return to their 20-minute rotation on Monday.Burning Springs**Quests**

**Insurrection** – Relogging during the objective to speak to Eugene at the end of the quest no longer causes the player to become blocked if they attempt to talk to Eugene again.
**When the Rust Settles** – Relogging during the “Prove yourself” objective no longer blocks the player from interacting with Eugene, blocking quest progression.
**When the Rust Settles** – Relogging during the arena fight objective no longer blocks progression.
**Dirty Laundry**

- Abraxodyne Intel cases no longer respawn upon cell reset after players have collected them.
**Dirty Laundry** – The 'Prototype ABX03' weapon now appears in Windy's trade inventory after completing the challenge.**Misc**

- Rad hogs can now be dismembered when targeting their limbs.
- Player title prefix “Dusty” now persists after relog.
- New Main Menu video has been added for launch.
- Fixed an issue where Bounty Posters were not craftable after completing the corresponding challenge to unlock them.
- Fixed an issue where each My Stash Box variant was showing the same name and recipe. General

- Fixed cryo slow being applied to players who aren't in PvP.
- Fixed an issue where Hack and Slash could damage players outside of PvP.

## PTS Patchnotes 31.10.2025

### PTS Update – October 31, 2025: Burning Springs

### Gearin’ Up

- Tamed Deathclaw now correctly leaves cage during event and returns after event.
- Tamed Deathclaw is no longer stuck during the “Fend off the Snallygasters” stage of the event.
- Deathclaw Matriarch and adds now correctly path to Tamed Deathclaw if it doesn’t reach the lower area of the junkyard.
### Quests

- Quest titles have been updated with final names for launch: "Welcoming Committee", "Might Makes Right", "Insurrection" and "When the Rust Settles"
- Relogging during the Dirty Laundry quest no longer causes some Abraxodyne Intel to disappear if not already collected.
**Insurrection**: Relogging during the “Find the Key” step no longer causes the key to despawn.
**Insurrection**: Going to Moose’s house and interacting with the intercom now prompts Moose to ask for the password.
